versions.changelog: v3.0: Unified pack+dispatch cron, silent day fast path, importance tiers (P0/P1/P2), cross-group correlation, OQ health tracking, schedule priorities, weekly quality audit
v2.1: midnight race fix, dispatch dedup, DM privacy, schedule dedup, 3-day rolling snapshots, send logging, MEMORY guard rails, time perspective fix

- Initial release of deepsleep skill: automated two-phase daily memory management for AI agents.
- Nightly "deep sleep pack" phase at 23:40 summarizes and persists key conversation data, filters by importance, and tracks open questions.
- Morning "dispatch" phase at 00:10 delivers per-group briefs and alerts from the stored summaries.
- Auto-discovers sessions and filters persisted content by criteria such as decisions, lessons, and milestones.
- Requires cron setup for both phases and initial memory configuration.
